mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_form_schema (process_definition_key, activity_id, name, version, schema_json, enabled, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{processDefinitionKey}, #{activityId}, #{name}, COALESCE(#{version}, 1), #{schemaJson}, COALESCE(#{enabled}, 1), #{createBy}, NOW(), #{updateBy}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, process_definition_key, activity_id, name, version, schema_json, enabled, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM wf_form_schema WHERE process_definition_key = #{processDefinitionKey} AND activity_id = #{activityId} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, process_definition_key, activity_id, name, version, schema_json, enabled, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM wf_form_schema WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, process_definition_key, activity_id, name, version, schema_json, enabled, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM wf_form_schema WHERE process_definition_key = #{processDefinitionKey} ORDER BY activity_id ASC, version DESC
